description: React component for displaying card limit notifications, snooze options, and admin contact prompts in a web application.

methods.name: onCloseHidden
methods.description: Handles snoozing the card limit notification by updating user config.

methods.name: onCloseWarning
methods.description: Handles snoozing the hidden card warning by updating user config.

methods.name: handleContactAdminClicked
methods.description: Tracks event and notifies admin to upgrade plan.
